lessons.title: Say the specific thing
lessons.objective: Answer 'what do you do?' with one specific, interesting line, then stop.

lessons.title: Turn it back
lessons.objective: After your answer, ask one real question back within ten seconds.

lessons.title: Remember their name
lessons.objective: Use their name once, naturally, before the conversation ends.

lessons.title: Introduce someone else
lessons.objective: Introduce a friend with one detail that makes the other person curious.

lessons.title: The boring answer
lessons.objective: Make an ordinary job or major sound interesting without exaggerating.

lessons.title: Checkpoint
lessons.objective: A cold introduction with an unfamiliar character at Real pressure.

lessons.title: Three beats
lessons.objective: Tell a 30-second story with a setup, a turn and a final line.

lessons.title: Land the ending
lessons.objective: End a story on a full stop instead of trailing off or explaining it.

lessons.title: Read the table
lessons.objective: Shorten your story when the listener's interest drops.

lessons.title: Cut off mid-story
lessons.objective: When interrupted, let the story go and rejoin within a minute.

lessons.title: Make them the hero
lessons.objective: Tell a story where someone else gets the best line.

lessons.title: Checkpoint
lessons.objective: Tell a story to a talker who keeps cutting in, at Real pressure.

lessons.title: No, once
lessons.objective: Decline a request clearly with at most one reason.

lessons.title: The second ask
lessons.objective: Hold your no when they push, without adding new excuses.

lessons.title: Disagree out loud
lessons.objective: Disagree with someone senior, calmly, with one reason.

lessons.title: Take credit
lessons.objective: Claim your contribution without accusing anyone.

lessons.title: Apologise once
lessons.objective: Apologise cleanly for a real mistake, once, then move on.

lessons.title: Checkpoint
lessons.objective: Hold a boundary against a skeptic at Heat pressure.

lessons.title: The first ten minutes
lessons.objective: Be at ease and curious. Ask one question that isn't on a form.

lessons.title: Take the tease
lessons.objective: Take a light tease with ease and hand the attention back.

lessons.title: Say what you want
lessons.objective: State a preference (where to go, what to order) without asking permission.

lessons.title: The awkward pause
lessons.objective: Let a silence sit, then restart with something specific.

lessons.title: Ask to see her again
lessons.objective: Ask clearly and warmly, and accept either answer gracefully.

lessons.title: Checkpoint
lessons.objective: A distracted date at Real pressure: earn attention without chasing it.

lessons.title: Join the group
lessons.objective: Enter a conversation already happening without taking it over.

lessons.title: The toast
lessons.objective: Give a 30-second toast: one story, one line, glass up.

lessons.title: Talked over
lessons.objective: Get the floor back when someone talks over you, without raising your voice.

lessons.title: Leave well
lessons.objective: Leave a conversation warmly and cleanly.

lessons.title: Host the table
lessons.objective: Bring a quiet person into the conversation.

lessons.title: Checkpoint
lessons.objective: Join a reserved senior group and leave a mark, at Heat pressure.
